discriminant_groups.inference_rule: For each relevant prime p, rank modulo p counts Smith factors not divisible by p.  Here each determinant valuation equals the number of divisible factors, so no factor contains p^2; divisibility ordering fixes the displayed invariant factors.

G.direct_summand_test: An A2 direct summand contains norm-two vectors, while G has exact minimum 28.

Q.direct_summand_test: The same even-root-component criterion; complete exact root components have sizes 240 and 72, never six.

S.direct_summand_test: In an even orthogonal decomposition A2+R, every norm-two vector lies wholly in one summand; the six A2 roots must therefore be a size-six nonorthogonality component.  The complete exact root enumeration has only components of sizes 240 and 72.
